description: Returns one Action Plan Item. Use `view=details` to include the item's references and test records in the same response.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Selects the response shape. `normal` (default) returns the full item; `extended` adds the parent plan and plan section; `flat_v0` returns a bare `status_id`; `details` returns the `extended` item p...

403.description: Forbidden. The user cannot view Action Plans, or cannot view the Action Plan this item belongs to.

404.description: Not Found. Action Plan Item does not exist.
